reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute tickets doubled from ~600/month to 1180 (Aug) and 1260 (Sep) 2026 (E-02), despite response times staying within SLA (median 1.6d/p90 2.8d vs 3.0d, E-01) and no recorded tariff change (E-05), while 59% of disputed bills carried ACTUAL meter reads rather than ESTIMATED substitutes (E-04). This pattern indicates the billing import + validation step itself is generating incorrect bills regardless of read availability, driving the surge, rather than a response-capacity gap or missing-read estimate substitution being the dominant cause.
